description: Extracts the substring from the specified string starting from the left character and is intended for languages that use the double-byte character set (DBCS) like Japanese, Chinese, Korean etc.

params.description: The text string containing the characters to extract.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A number of the substring characters, based on bytes.
params.name: arg2

signature: LEFTB(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | string, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): string
